notes.title: 🔞 "Roomies with a Naughty Comic Artist" Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Ever fantasized about living under the same roof with a sexy, lazy adult manga artist?
Now’s your chance—[b]the demo of "Roomies with a Naughty Comic Artist"[/b] is making its debut during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], and it’s completely free to try![/p][p]In this mature-themed visual novel, you’ll play as a rookie editor who’s forced to move in with the ultra-popular erotic manga artist, [b]Eri[/b].
From cooking and cleaning to helping her brainstorm steamy scenes, your job is anything but ordinary.[/p][p]You're supposed to be her assistant… but living together stirs up all kinds of [b]naughty tension[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602842/94010a89b6a4e1728ddec6c9a2fdb5b684fb4ec9.png"][/img][/p][p]🛠️ [b]Still in Development — More to Come![/b][/p][p]This demo showcases only the early structure and tone of the game.
The final version will feature [b]many more CGs, expanded branching routes, and fully polished adult scenes[/b]—so stay tuned![/p][p]We warmly welcome your feedback after playing the demo, and invite you to be part of building the most dangerously addicting cohabitation story ever.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602842/241aef36e2523df96cd0b366c60d1a394ce95638.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]⏰ [b]Limited-Time Next Fest Demo[/b] — Add it to your wishlist now and dive into this delightfully indecent everyday life![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561090/_/?curator_clanid=4777282"][/dynamiclink][/p]
